headline: North Korea expels Swiss diplomat after Switzerland sanctions children camp linked to Russia
label: NEWS
caption:
North Korea has kicked out the head of Switzerland’s diplomatic office in Pyongyang following a fierce sanctions dispute 🇨🇭.

According to North Korea's foreign ministry, the decision to expel diplomat Sylvain Astier came after Switzerland placed sanctions on the Songdowon International Children’s Camp.

Kim Yo Jong, a top foreign policy official and sister to leader Kim Jong Un, condemned the move as an open hostile act and a violation of sovereignty.

Swiss authorities added the camp to their sanctions list over allegations it was used to host and indoctrinate children from Russian occupied areas of Ukraine.

Switzerland stated it regrets the decision and will continue diplomatic relations through its embassy in Beijing and North Korea's embassy in Bern.
